# 120 — Configuration_Loaded

Reports that a configuration candidate was successfully obtained for validation\.

[All events](index.md) · [Configuration category](Category_Configuration.md) · [API reference](xref:Patware.Diagnostics.ApplicationEvents.ConfigurationEvents.Loaded%28System.String%2CSystem.String%2CSystem.String%29)

| Field | Value |

| EventId | 120 |
| Name | Configuration_Loaded |
| Category | [Configuration](Category_Configuration.md) |
| Event class | LowLevel |
| Log level | Information |
| Status | Proposed |
| Introduced | Unpublished |

## Usage

Import `Patware.Diagnostics.ApplicationEvents`. This example assumes an existing
`ILogger` named `logger` and caller-supplied variables for the arguments.

```csharp
logger.Configuration.Loaded(@configurationName, @sourceName, @loadId);
```

**Trigger:** Emit after source access, reading, and any required parsing or deserialization successfully produce a candidate, before evaluating application validation rules\.

**Message template:** Configuration loaded\. Configuration: \{ConfigurationName\}\. Source: \{SourceName\}\. Load: \{LoadId\}\.

## Arguments

- `configurationName` (`string`): The non\-sensitive logical name of the configuration being loaded\.
- `sourceName` (`string`): The non\-sensitive logical source name\. Do not include credentials, connection strings, or sensitive paths or addresses\.
- `loadId` (`string`): The identifier of the successfully completed loading attempt\.

## Remarks

- Use the same ConfigurationName, SourceName, and LoadId as the corresponding Configuration\_Loading event\.
- Successful loading establishes that a candidate was obtained\. It does not establish that the candidate is valid, has been applied, or is currently active\.
- Loading succeeds even when subsequent application validation rejects the candidate\. Report that rejection through the configuration\-validation events\.
- Do not emit this event when parsing or deserialization fails, when loading is cancelled, or when an optional source is absent and no candidate is obtained\.
- A successful load after an earlier failure does not by itself establish application recovery or a change in operating mode\.
- Names must be non\-sensitive\. Configuration contents are deliberately excluded from the event contract\.
- Calling this method only emits a diagnostic record\. It does not validate or apply configuration, replace active settings, or change application mode\.
